_help: Omarchy's own apps built for Windows (.github/workflows/ports.yml), one self-contained x64 zip each. Filled in by hand from a ports workflow run's output (url and sha256), so an install never downloads something this file has not pinned. An app appears in Install > Omarchy Apps once it has a url.

apps.label: Omawrite
apps.note: Omarchy's writing app. Super + Shift + W.

apps.label: Omacut
apps.note: Omarchy's video trimmer. It uses FFmpeg (Install > Windows > FFmpeg).

apps.label: Hype (presentations)
apps.note: Omarchy's presentation app. Video export uses FFmpeg (Install > Windows > FFmpeg).

apps.label: Aether (theme maker)
apps.note: Makes a theme from a picture; winarchy theme <name> applies it.
